// Recursive copy that keeps symlinks as symlinks, like stylepak's copyDir.
bool copyDir(const QString &src, const QString &dst, QString *err)
{
    if (!QDir().mkpath(dst)) {
        *err = QStringLiteral("cannot create %1").arg(dst);
        return false;
    }
    const QDir d(src);
    const auto entries = d.entryInfoList(QDir::AllEntries | QDir::NoDotAndDotDot | QDir::System
                                         | QDir::Hidden);
    for (const QFileInfo &fi : entries) {
        const QString target = dst + QLatin1Char('/') + fi.fileName();
        if (fi.isSymLink()) {
            QFile::remove(target);
            if (!QFile::link(fi.symLinkTarget(), target)) {
                *err = QStringLiteral("cannot create symlink %1").arg(target);
                return false;
            }
        } else if (fi.isDir()) {
            if (!copyDir(fi.absoluteFilePath(), target, err))
                return false;
        } else {
            QFile::remove(target);
            if (!QFile::copy(fi.absoluteFilePath(), target)) {
                *err = QStringLiteral("cannot copy %1").arg(fi.absoluteFilePath());
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool copyThemeFiles(const QString &src, const QString &dst, QString *err)
{
    int copied = 0;
    const QDir d(src);
    for (const QFileInfo &fi : d.entryInfoList(QDir::Dirs | QDir::NoDotAndDotDot)) {
        if (!fi.fileName().startsWith(QLatin1String("gtk-")))
            continue;
        if (!copyDir(fi.absoluteFilePath(), dst + QLatin1Char('/') + fi.fileName(), err))
            return false;
        ++copied;
    }
    if (copied == 0) {
        *err = QStringLiteral("no gtk-* directories found in theme %1").arg(src);
        return false;
    }
    const QString index = src + QStringLiteral("/index.theme");
    if (QFileInfo::exists(index)) {
        const QString out = dst + QStringLiteral("/index.theme");
        QFile::remove(out);
        if (!QFile::copy(index, out)) {
            *err = QStringLiteral("cannot copy index.theme");
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void removeStaleThemes(const QString &themesDir, const QString &current)
{
    const QDir d(themesDir);
    for (const QFileInfo &fi : d.entryInfoList(QDir::Dirs | QDir::NoDotAndDotDot)) {
        if (fi.fileName() == current || !isManaged(fi.absoluteFilePath()))
            continue;
        QDir(fi.absoluteFilePath()).removeRecursively();
    }
}

}  // namespace

## Assistant

Yes, it only edits configuration. It's careful in most places, but it is not fully non-destructive, and it can't undo what it writes. I haven't run any of it, so this comes from reading the code.

**What it does**
- **Nothing is written until you press Apply.** Changes stay in memory until then, and the "Unapplied changes" tab shows what Apply would do.
- **Settings it writes on Apply:**
  - gsettings/dconf values (`gsettings set`, checked by reading them back).
  - `qt5ct.conf`, `qt6ct.conf`, `kdeglobals`, and on KDE `kcminputrc`.
  - On KineticWE, `appearance.kwe` and `kineticwe.kwe`.
- **It also writes GTK export files:** `settings.ini`, `~/.gtkrc-2.0`, `xsettingsd.conf`, and `~/.icons/default/index.theme`.
- **It sends a D-Bus notification** so running Qt and KDE apps pick up the change.
- **The `.conf`/`.kwe`/`kdeglobals`/`kcminputrc` writes are gentle.** Each is atomic and changes only the keys it manages, leaving your other lines alone.

**Where it overwrites or deletes**
- `~/.gtkrc-2.0`, `xsettingsd.conf`, `~/.icons/default/index.theme` and `gtk-4.0/settings.ini` are replaced as whole files, and there is no backup. Any hand edits in them are lost. For `~/.gtkrc-2.0`, put additions in `~/.gtkrc-2.0.mine`. `gtk-3.0/settings.ini` keeps lines it doesn't recognise.
- **GTK4 theme links** are off by default. When on, the app creates symlinks. When turned off, it removes only symlinks it made, and never regular files. That protects Noctalia's `gtk.css`.
- **Flatpak options** are all off by default. They run `flatpak override --user` and, if you enable "install current theme", copy the theme into `~/.themes`. It later deletes only theme copies carrying its own marker file.
- **Palette and style sheet files:** you can create, rename and remove them yourself in your qt5ct/qt6ct folders. Removing a palette asks for confirmation. The Noctalia and KDE schemes are read-only.
- **`--restore-defaults` (`-r`)** resets the GTK settings, and asks first unless you pass `-y`.
- **Nothing is undone automatically.** The one safety net is a gsettings backup the app saves in `~/.local/share/lgl-kwe-look/gsettings`, which `-a` can re-apply.

**Two more things**
- **Test on a copy first.** Since you're on your real Noctalia setup, run with a scratch home first: `HOME=/tmp/kwe-test build-release/lgl-kwe-look`. That writes only to `/tmp/kwe-test`.
- **Copy the files above** if you care about hand edits in them before pressing Apply.

If you want a real safety net, I can add a backup step that copies each file into a timestamped folder before overwriting it, and a "restore last backup" button.
